Program: NDPC Data Protection Officer Training and Certification Programme
Content: OFFICIAL PROGRAMME GUIDANCE — this is NDPC programme admission guidance, not an additional qualification prescribed by section 32 of the NDPA. The NDPC programme page lists an educational background of a bachelor's degree or equivalent in Law, Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or Business Administration; alternatively it lists CIPP, CIPM, ISO 27001, or equivalent. It also asks for demonstrated interest in data protection (such as publications, workshops, or seminars) and a personal statement, plus proficiency with digital technologies, IT systems, data-management tools, and compliance frameworks. Programme application windows and requirements can change; check the official page for the current cohort and instructions.
